query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'APPROVED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RECEIVED')) AND (r."CREDIT_MINOR" > r."SETTLED_MINOR") THEN ((0 + r."CREDIT_MINOR") - r."SETTLED_MINOR") ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."CURRENCY") = RTRIM(:p_currency)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::RETURN_LIABILITY" (
  IN rows TABLE ("COMPANY" NVARCHAR(4), "CURRENCY" NVARCHAR(3), "STATUS" NVARCHAR(12), "CREDIT_MINOR" BIGINT, "SETTLED_MINOR" BIGINT),
  IN p_company NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_currency NVARCHAR(255),
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'APPROVED') OR (RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'RECEIVED')) AND (r."CREDIT_MINOR" > r."SETTLED_MINOR") THEN ((0 + r."CREDIT_MINOR") - r."SETTLED_MINOR") ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."CURRENCY") = RTRIM(:p_currency)));
END;

semantics.characterComparison: RTRIM preserves ABAP fixed-character trailing-space comparison
semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
